title: Pick a compatible OTA update
summary: Choose the newest over-the-air update that matches the binary's runtime version and channel.
prompt: Write `pickUpdate(device, updates)`. A device is `{ runtimeVersion, channel, currentUpdateId, installId }`. Each update is `{ id, runtimeVersion, channel, createdAt, rolloutPercent, rolledBack? }`. An update is eligible when its runtime version and channel equal the device's exactly, it is not rolled back, and the device is inside the rollout: `bucket(installId, id) < rolloutPercent`. Use the provided `bucket` helper. Return the eligible update with the latest `createdAt`, or `null`. Return `null` too if that update is the one already running (`currentUpdateId`). If the currently running update has been rolled back and no other eligible update exists, return `{ id: 'embedded' }` so the app falls back to the bundle shipped in the binary. There is no React Native runtime here, so this is modelled as plain TypeScript.
hints: Filter first, then reduce to the newest.
Never compare runtime versions with `<`: they are opaque strings that must match exactly.
